items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: The Jackson Muehler fixed that up, you know what I mean?

ctx.x: All the way across up there in black letters. Yeah, in San Jacinto.

Yeah. And I had one put downstairs and I fixed that little board on there. The Jackson Muehler fixed that up, you know what I mean? That one up at the top was made with the club. The letters was cut out and the spot was painted black. Then they had all the names, the San Jacinto club.
See, in the late 20s, that club was up because I used to go to rehearsal. Yeah. So San Jacinto probably was up before the 20s. Oh yeah, I'm sure it was.
